why: ChatGPT answered with five standalone battery projectors (MoGo 4 Laser, MoGo 4, Mars 3 Air, BenQ GV50, Mars 3) and named no accessory the shopper must add; its follow-up questions are about where it's used and whether a battery is needed, which both decide a model, not a set. A screen or power bank is optional, and no sizing or compatibility fact makes a multi-item set necessary, so this is a single-product comparison (Dealectric lists XGIMI MoGo 4, Nebula Capsule 3, Aurzen ZIP Pro and others to compare).
